activities.name: produce
activities.run:
set -eu
printf 'route=hpc-local
sequence=1
' > payload.txt
sha256sum payload.txt > payload.sha256
test -s payload.txt

activities.name: consume
activities.run:
set -eu
test -s payload.txt
sha256sum -c payload.sha256
grep -qx 'route=hpc-local' payload.txt
printf 'consumed=local
' > receipt.txt
test -s receipt.txt
